subject: Another try for the blog - twitter?

messages.author: b24c10731fdfceaf
messages.subject: Another try for the blog - twitter?
parts:
Hello dear R GSoC participants.

The GSoC-blog is now changed from a "blog" into a "twitter/facebook-wall":
http://gsoc2010r.wordpress.com/

Motivation: Since the old blog format wasn't taking off (for most useRs), I have made the changes (with permission from Dirk).
Implications: Now the front page of the blog, and the place to publish new things are the same place.
Hopes: I hope that now people might consider using it for more day to day updates.  In the line of "did this - feeling nice" or "here's an example of..." sort of thing.  Instead of seeing the blog as a place for journal level articles.

Steps of use (really easy)
1) Register - to wordpress.com (on  http://en.wordpress.com/signup/)
2) Login - and go to the blog: http://gsoc2010r.wordpress.com/
3) Publish - You can enter a status update to the blog, just as if it was twitter (only not limited to 140 chars, and you can add pictures if you want)

I hope this will prove to be more useful.

If you have any questions or thoughts on the subject (or if you wish to change it back to how it was), please let me know.

With regards,
Tal
